title: Conecuh Sausage Company Inc — claimed by interlock
description: US · Agriculture and Food Production · Conecuh Sausage, a family-owned sausage company in Alabama, is known for its hickory-smoked pork sausages made with a proprietary, closely guarded seasoning blend. However, due to a lax approach to security, customer data, payment information, secret recipes/intellectual property, projects, personnel records, and supplier contracts were compromised and are now exposed.
